ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with low-intensity (black) pixels occupying ~70% of the central and anterior fluke surface, contrasted with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels occupying ~30% in posterior-lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) pigmentation across the fluke core and leading edges. The left lobe contains a white high-contrast region with embedded dark linear streaks. The right lobe contains a broader white high-contrast region with multiple scattered dark focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with low-amplitude peaks (~5-10 pixels) and irregular coarse protrusions at the lateral lobe terminals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent convex curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips, with a pronounced posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, dark, roughly circular pixel focal points visible against the high-intensity white background of the right lobe; irregular dark clusters (barnacles) are attached to both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, dark diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) on the high-intensity white portion of the left lobe; single short vertical mark on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent external barnacle clusters attached to the lateral-most points of both lobes; distinct linear rake marks visible on the left lobe's ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of both lobes exhibit irregular, protruding biomass (barnacles) that breaks the smooth geometric contour of the fluke edges.
